evidence.summary: DOJ identifies Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud and one initial count of knowingly receiving a firearm and ammunition to commit a federal terrorism crime. The release describes an inert rifle and unproven allegations. The live account now follows those records.
evidence.limits: The initial DOJ release and complaint support the corrected name and firearm-receipt count. Allegations remain unproven. No refreshed docket or later court outcome was checked. This is not a full fact-check.

corrections.note: Corrected the defendant’s name to Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud and the initial charge to knowingly receiving a firearm and ammunition to commit a federal terrorism crime. Removed unsupported arrest/courtroom scenes and certainty about intent; attributed the complaint allegations and added presumption of innocence.
